A decision you can explain. A search you can follow.

  1. Agree the brief

    We discuss your total budget, use, timing and non-negotiables. Before a paid assignment, you receive the proposed scope, duration, deliverables, responsible professionals and fees in writing.

  2. Compare the right homes

    The proposed search brings together relevant listings, their sources, asking prices and compromises. Availability and permissions are checked before a home is presented as ready for a viewing.

  3. See what you are buying

    Where included in the agreed scope, local visits or live video produce a written account of what was observed, what was reported by the seller and what still needs professional inspection.

  4. Prepare the next decision

    We coordinate the agreed next steps with the appointed local professionals. Technical, legal, tax and finance checks are assigned to the appropriate specialists. You approve any offer and commitment.

The scope first. The fee in writing.

The initial enquiry is free. Buying assignments are quoted individually after a feasibility review. The proposal sets out BOOM’s fee, applicable taxes, payment stages, duration and cancellation terms. Third-party costs and any other agency commissions are identified separately before you accept.

The rental PFS and European rental desk prices do not apply to purchases. A submitted brief does not start a property search or reserve a home.

Discuss my purchase

Before you start

Can I ask BOOM to help me buy anywhere in Europe?

Yes, you can submit an enquiry for any European destination, including Rome. Acceptance depends on local feasibility and the professionals required. We confirm the place, scope and fees before a mandate starts.

Is BOOM already a local agency in every country?

No. BOOM is operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency based in Rome. We do not claim offices or transaction licences throughout Europe. Regulated work abroad requires appropriately authorised local professionals.

Can I start while living abroad?

Yes. Tell us where you live and whether you can travel. We can assess a scope with remote coordination, local visits and video reports. The proposal states what is available in your destination.

What if I have already found a property?

Choose “I already have a listing” and include its link. Tell us whether you have contacted the seller or an agency. We will assess the support possible and any existing commitments before proposing work.

How much does a buying search cost?

The initial enquiry is free. There is no universal European purchase tariff: scope, duration, BOOM’s fee, taxes and separately payable professional or agency costs are set out in writing before acceptance.

Do you guarantee a purchase, discount or return?

No. We cannot guarantee that a suitable home will be found, an offer accepted, finance approved or an investment return achieved. You retain the final decision, with the relevant professional checks.

How is buying different from the rental desks?

Buying uses a separate brief, a total purchase budget and an individually agreed mandate. The BOOM rental desk services and their fixed fees remain separate.
